audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 is awarded to Swain at 7/10 while its own why and the early text both say Yone wins the straight Level 1 trade outright ('You concede this level entirely'). Level 3 and First item are given to Yone though their whys describe both stages as even or 'genuinely contested'. Packet chart: Yone/Skill/Skill/Yone/Swain/Skill/Yone.
audit.why: Three rows contradicted their own explanations, and this is a losing matchup at 47.98% over 421 games — the chart should not be handing Swain the level he explicitly concedes.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Yone (3/10), rows 2 and 5 to Skill (5/10); win[] and phases[].side proposed as pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Yone's Levels 1-2, your Level 6, his first item, and his two-item window. Fate Sealed at 120/100/80 s matches the described level-6 reassessment, and Soul Unbound at 22/19/16/13/10 s is what the whole page is built around tracking.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound's rank-1 22 s cooldown added so 'track the rewind' has a number attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two Don't entries carry only generic filler. Nothing states that Spirit Cleave (W) shields Yone — scaling with the number of champions hit — or that Mortal Steel needs two stacks before the third cast knocks up.
audit.why: Both are in Riot's own text. The shield is what eats your opening burst, and the two-stack arming is the tell that his all-in is one cast away.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d now describes the Q stacking tell; dontsFull[1].d names the Spirit Cleave shield.
sources: enemyKit W text and shield flag

audit.why: Soul Unbound is correctly identified as the punishable cooldown and the return-snap as the root window. Only the duration of that punish window was unquantified, now fixed at 22 s rank 1.

edits.before: W-into-E is online but Yone dodges E with Q dashes and snaps back with Soul Unbound — this stage is even only if you track his rewind activation icon before throwing E.
edits.after: W-into-E is online but Yone dodges with Q dashes and snaps back with Soul Unbound — it is down 22 s at rank 1, so throw E only once that rewind has been spent.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel hits arm the third — the knock-up is what starts his all-in.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields him per champion hit — poke it off before you commit.

notes: Chart rows 0, 2 and 5 flipped to packet.levelChart as matched pairs. Both flagged suspectNames are false positives — 'Soul Unbound' and 'Demonic Ascension' are correct.
